_: Lessons cut from the practice workbooks (Levels 1 and 2 of the app). Each entry: the app's lesson number (its identity, never its position), the workbook section it is cut from (a section id as printed in the master's Table of Contents), the sheet the author records and edits, and the words the home page shows. Optional: `tips` — the lines shown over a page, keyed by the workbook's printed page number ('56') or by a run of the sheet's card numbers on that page ('56:39-44', its own screen), replacing the master's ★ Tip lines; `notes` — a word's own rule chip, by its exact text, replacing the rule the master prints above its table; `columns` — 2 for a page laid out as the paper's right and left boxes (keyed by printed page), so each row's pair stays side by side, right box first. Run: node scripts/make-workbook-lessons.mjs [numbers]
